'''Deena Shan's father''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] from [[Etti IV/Legends|Etti IV]]. He had always dreamed of leaving his [[Planet/Legends|world]], but was forced into an early [[Marriage/Legends|marriage]] by the birth of [[Deena Shan|his daughter]]. He had wanted a boy, and discouraged her attempts to make her way in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], always telling her that she would be back soon enough.
